Rebrand or refresh? How to tell which one you need. A thread.
Refresh if people like you but your look feels dated. Same personality, better clothes.
Rebrand if you've changed what you do, who you serve, or how big you want to be. The old brand can't tell the new story.
Neither, if the real problem is the product or the service. Design can't fix that, and we'll tell you so.
